name: Cirrus Communications
summary: Licensed fixed-wireless broadband carrier for regional Australia; serial acquirer of small regional wireless ISPs (CommsLogic 2007, WireFree 2008, UniSky 2008, LiSP wireless, My WiSP, Chariot wireless assets); rebranded Swoop ~2021 via reverse takeover.

events.details: Cirrus Communications founded, Gosford NSW (fixed wireless). Live by the earliest Wayback capture, 12 Jul 2005.
Rebranded Swoop; merged into Swoop Holdings via reverse takeover.

ACN attribution caveat: the entity CIRRUS PTY LTD (ACN 636 256 052, ABN 17 636 256 052, NSW 2023) does not correspond to the 2003 Gosford operating company — its ACN was registered ~2019 and its ABN is active only from 1 Sep 2021, postdating both the founding and the ~May 2021 Swoop rebrand, and its name (CIRRUS PTY LTD, not Cirrus Communications) and Sydney address differ. It appears to be a later Swoop-group brand-holding entity; the operating company's ABN is not currently locatable (no active 'Cirrus Communications' on ABR — likely cancelled/renamed after the reverse takeover).
source: https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=17636256052 (CIRRUS PTY LTD, ABN active from 01 Sep 2021, NSW 2023)
